scope: Same 24 conditions, four validation scenes, four sample seeds and one training seed per package. No method is promoted and no final test split is opened.

metric_scope.motion_window: full 32-frame clip for zero/passive; first 0.5 seconds for reversal/selection
metric_scope.coverage: all four selected trajectories required per case; retain undefined values and scored scene counts
metric_scope.intervals: 2,000 scene-group bootstrap replicates; conditional on checkpoints, no training-seed interval
metric_scope.contact_frequency: descriptive finite-ensemble occurrence, not calibrated probability

quality.scope: Strict single-reference engineering check. Hidden-physics coverage and action response are reported separately; this is not a physical-validity guarantee.
